exposure: access to a web-based price transparency tool
outcome: Searches on the price transparency tool by delivery mode
Association of out-of-pocket childbirth spending with price transparency tool use
cohort: Two cohorts of enrollees aged 19 to 45 years who had a delivery episode between November 1, 2011, and December 31, 2016, and were continuously enrolled for the 10 months prior to delivery (N = 253,606) from a US commercial health insurance company
finding: The study found that price transparency tool use by pregnant individuals more than doubled within the first 6 years of availability, and that searching was associated with higher out-of-pocket spending.
